Plan and Refine in .md Before You Build
Refine the plan, not the build: editing text is cheaper than rebuilding an app
1
Ask for a plan, not the app
“Write plan.md for this app. Don't build yet.”
2
Review and edit the plan
Add, cut or reorder features in plain text
3
Approve the plan
Lock the scope before any building starts
4
Build from the plan
“Build v1 exactly as described in plan.md”

# Lead Capture App: Plan
## Goal
- Capture course leads in one place
## Users
- Marketing team, prospects
## v1 Features
1. Sign-up form
2. Thank-you email
3. Leads dashboard
## Out of scope (v1)
- CRM sync, payments

Repetitive & Complex Tasks with SKILL.md
Package a repeatable task once; Claude follows it every time
A SKILL IS A FOLDER
campaign-report/
├─ SKILL.md
├─ template.md
├─ brand-guide.md
└─ examples/
Write once, reuse every time
Claude loads a skill only when the task needs it
